title: Thrift: Multiple fixes in compact protocol
description:
- Do not interprete the byte after a boolean field header as the field itself.
  Create a generated field from the field type instead.
- Create the generated boolean in the generic dissector only.
  The specific field was already generated in case of boolean type.

Closes #19398

- Correctly check size of method name in Compact Protocol heuristic.
  Prevent false positives that would call the dissector again after reassembly.
- Allow framed dissection to be called with more data than advertized in the frame.


(cherry picked from commit 61696e68d4b39525e329cd85f1765bbcf2465db1)
